messages:
sam: lunchtime cuteness drop 12 meet Bagel, my one-eyed tabby, showing off her new thrift-store bandana. pic: https://imgur.com/a/BagelBandana :blush:
nora: THAT EYE PATCH is giving pirate energy :pirate_flag: :joy:
diego: fashion icon. can confirm bandana pairs well with coffee stains. :coffee:
anya: how did she lose her eye?? heartbroken but so cute :broken_heart:
sam: accident as a kitten, all healed now. vet said shes a champ. she follows me around like a tiny shadow. :cat2:
claire: vote: bandana is chefs kiss. :one: for bandana, :two: for eye-patch aesthetic
(reactions: nora :one:, diego :one:)
paws-bot: Heads up: Office pet showcase sign-up opens Fri 3pm. Submit photos by Thu EOD. https://redwood.example.com/pet-showcase
sam: uploaded photo: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T11111-F22222/bagel_bandana.jpg
anya: putting Bagel in the calendar as VIP :star: ; also will bring treats in case Bagel demands tribute
diego: unsolicited caption: "Bagel: Master of the One-Eyed Wink" :wink:
claire: ok whos bringing a dog for co-working day? im allergic but will wear a mask for the content :sweat_smile:
nora: i can bring pesto the pug next week if no SARS from pets :sweat_smile:
sam: pledge to bring Bagel on the virtual panel for aesthetic support :camera_with_flash:
